bibliographic.title: Richard Quest: Canada™ Edition
bibliographic.author: Will Vale
bibliographic.description:
A Christmastime jaunt through Lovecraft Country, only it's in Canada™.

RQCE grew out of experimenting with Twine so that I could stay just ahead of my daughter's learning to write Twine games. It turned into something a bit bigger, and plays a bit like a traditional parser game. Although it isn't possible to get stuck (I hope!) and you don't have to type anything.

More importantly, it's inspired by a series of narrated parser games written and performed by my brother Richard as Christmas entertainments. By which I mean we sat around while he read out descriptions, and we said "GO WEST, NO WAIT EAST!" and he said "I don't understand WAIT." They were very funny.

Richard maintains this game is non-canon in the Richard Quest oeuvre. He's probably got a point.
